description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Technological Service 4th Amendment
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Technological Service, specifically detailing departmental tests, efficiency bar examinations, promotion criteria, and interim provisions for public service officers. The content focuses on public service recruitment procedures, examination requirements, and service conditions under the authority of the Public Service Commission, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) covering public service recruitment, examinations, and service conditions.
